messages.en:
{07 19 00}The {ff 00 00 06}barista{ff 00 00 00} of this cafe

{07 11 00}coffee's got great taste,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 11 00}kohvil on hea maitse,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
The {ff 00 00 06}barista {ff 00 00 00}of this joint is

{07 14 00}I guess it would be rude

Selle paiga {ff 00 00 06}barista {ff 00 00 00}on

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}The {ff 00 00 06}barista{ff 00 00 00} here brews the
meanest cup of coffee in
town, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}It's definitely tastier than
the instant stuff I drink
at home, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Siinne {ff 00 00 06}barista{ff 00 00 00} keedab
linna kõige kangema tassi
kohvi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}See on kindlasti maitsvam
kui lahustuv kraam, mida
ma kodus joon, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 19 00}Ah, yeah. Now I remember{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 0f 00}I had a "disagreement" with
the leader of this gang in
a nearby town. 
After that, I sort of had
to split town, {01 00 00 05 00}and I ended
up wandering here{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{ff 00 00 06}{07 00 00}Brewster{ff 00 00 00} took me in and,
without a word, poured me
a cup of coffee.
{07 0a 00}I still remember how it
tasted, too.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. It was 
the boldest, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Ah, jah. Nüüd mäletan{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 0f 00}Mul oli „tüli” selle jõugu
juhiga ühes lähedases 
linnas. 
Pärast seda pidin ma
linnast lahkuma, {01 00 00 05 00}ja ma
sattusin siia{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{ff 00 00 06}{07 00 00}Brewster{ff 00 00 00} võttis mu vastu
ja kallas mulle sõnagi
lausumata tassi kohvi.
{07 0a 00}Ma mäletan ikka, kuidas
see maitses.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. See oli 
kõige kangem, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Sure, the coffee here might
just be the boldest in the
land...
{07 14 00}But that's only 'cause it's
brewed by {ff 00 00 06}Brewster{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 19 00}He's pretty much the 
greatest barista of his
generation.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Muidugi, siinne kohv võib
olla maal kõige kangem...

{07 14 00}Aga ainult sellepärast,
et selle keedab {ff 00 00 06}Brewster{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 19 00}Ta on üsna kindlalt oma 
põlvkonna parim
barista.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

messages.en:
That's what I like about
these old-school, owner-
operated cafes{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}It's the personal service
and attention that I like,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}I'm reminded about that
every time I walk into one
of those chain shops...
...and they don't know me
like {07 14 00}they do{01 01 00} at {ff 00 00 06}Brewster{ff 00 00 00}'s,
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
Just see mulle meeldibki
nende vanade, omaniku
peetud kohvikute juures{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Mulle meeldib isiklik
teenindus ja tähelepanu,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Mulle meenub see iga kord,
kui ma astun mõnda neist
ketipoodidest...
...ja nad ei tunne mind
nagu {07 14 00}nad{01 01 00} {ff 00 00 06}Brewsteri{ff 00 00 00} juures,
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}The only thing I don't like
about this place is they
won't make a mochaccino.
{07 0b 00}What?{01 01 00} You don't know what a
mochaccino is,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}? {01 01 00}Seriously?
{07 00 00}It's a cappucino...{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0d 00}with
CHOCOLATE!

{07 03 00}Well,{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}at least that's what 
the kids are calling it 
these days, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ainus asi, mis siin ei
meeldi, on see, et nad ei
tee mokatšiinot.
{07 0b 00}Mida?{01 01 00} Sa ei tea, mis on
mokatšiino,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}? {01 01 00}Tõsiselt?
{07 00 00}See on kapputšiino...{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0d 00}
ŠOKOLAADIGA!

{07 03 00}Noh,{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}vähemalt nii lapsed 
seda tänapäeval 
kutsuvad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 02 00}Whoa! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!


{07 14 00}This coffee is so strong
that the fumes are making
my eyes water!
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Ohoo! {01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 17 00}Just seda ma täna õhtul

You know those {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}cafes where

{07 00 00}Well, you've got to be
